critical_steps: Square-zero commuting Parrott tuple with derivative map of exactly unit norm.
Rational witness holomorphic near the closed tetrablock and contractive on every Shilov boundary point.
Real-symmetric tensor block has eigenvalues 1±rho, ±rho, yielding the exact amplification gap.
Only the centered equal-block Parrott class is covered by block-minimality.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic scalar spectral-set proof and distinguished-boundary defect identity, followed by exact four-eigenvalue amplification.
integrity.unproved_limits: Published geometric inputs are used; no claim to an absolute dimension minimum or the complete bounded norm outside the specified witness family.

scientific_limitations: General rational dilation failure and matrix interpolation are prior work; contribution is a particular exact finite constructive witness.
Restricted minimality does not address arbitrary commuting matrix tuples or non-centered block forms.

title: An explicit four-dimensional tetrablock spectral-set obstruction with a golden-ratio gap
